live_block_reason: RUNTIME_MODE is offline (default). No network model calls are made.

labels.specialist: Specialist review · lead, auditor and skeptic

investigation_modes.note: fast is the default for a live model; the scripted fixture defaults to specialist

live_model.note: configured does not mean a successful model call has been observed

capture_import.note: imports a directory with capture.json and its raw files as an unscored case; not offered over HTTP because it reads a local path. No captured evidence ships with this build

scenario_designer.never_chooses: incident steps, commands, destinations or strategy. Incidents are pre-authored scripted scenarios
scenario_designer.note: no model is configured: a default environment is returned and labeled as a default

report_export.note: available once a report is locked; never contains the sealed answer

sensor_streams.note: for a cold-chain case: the stored readings beside the independent reference logger, with the deterministic comparison. Evidence only, no model

source_experiments.note: derives a new evidence view with chosen sources withheld; the comparison of the original claims is deterministic and needs no model. A fresh investigation of the view is a separate run

questions.note: no model is configured: a question returns status 'unavailable'; the predefined, labeled explanations remain available
